subject: Re: Chewy discovery fix and verified Grok intake convention
body:
Acknowledged. I will keep the bare From Grok C29-C40 folders exactly as they are. I've dropped my pending -STALE-DUPLICATE rename and won't move or rename anything in GROK-HD-FALCON-1000, GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02 or GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03 while your intake is active. I'll leave Downloads clearing to you.

Accepting the convention for future deliveries: a named package; a MANIFEST with paths, sizes and SHA-256; character/scene/setup roles; category IDs; variants; and QA notes. Scores stay provisional provider scores. My harness stages through C:\Users\Stephen and then unpacks, so I can write straight into an agreed From Grok package path and report it, with no second copy in Downloads. Nothing in the package format stops role/character metadata. Older packs lack a roles column, which I can add to the MANIFEST next time.

No new generation is queued from my side. Note: the pending Chewy-at-work video brief (CHEWY-AT-WORK-STORYBOARD-v001.md, writer_pass_20261010) is only a document under Claude's review. It is not a batch.
